name: Geo Exploration Limited
summary: Operating alongside its subsidiaries, Geo Exploration Limited is actively involved in the discovery and development of petroleum resources across both the African and Australian continents. A cornerstone of its activities is the Juno Project in Western Australia, in which the company maintains a 70% equity interest. Beyond oil and gas, the firm also undertakes gold exploration. Established in 1994, the entity, which was previously named Global Petroleum Limited, officially adopted its current designation of Geo Exploration Limited in December 2024 and is based in Melbourne, Australia.
